name: WATonomous
description: The flagship autonomy design team at Waterloo, building software for autonomous vehicles, robotics platforms, and self-driving racecars.

cycles.notes: General membership is rolling admission across the Autonomous Software, Autonomous Platform, and Business Operations divisions, no deadline. WATcloud runs its own onboarding, either by picking up a listed starter project or filling out its onboarding form at cloud.watonomous.ca. The careers page also lists specific exec and lead hiring (Director, Project Manager, Squad Lead, Team Captain, Graphic Designer, Sales & Outreach Coordinator, Website Developer) plus an Expedited Admission track, all separate from general recruitment.
